notes: Phase 3E.2A: the hundreds-form expression for Section 323. As with D02, this is the DESIRED outcome -- do not expand production parsing merely to make this pass. 'hundred' is outside the approved SpokenNumberParser grammar (digit/tens words only), so this case is expected to surface a normalization gap, not a recognition gap. The statute token's 'ipc' spokenForm is a fixture correction (not a production change): a real-audio run produced lowercase 'ipc', which is the correct statute identity in non-canonical case, not a recognition or normalization failure -- spokenForm matching is case-insensitive by design, so this stops a casing artifact from scoring as a wrong/corrupted statute token. D01/D02 are not changed: their real-audio runs produced uppercase 'IPC', so there is no equivalent evidence-based justification for them.
